Absolute best night out in Da Nang
Jun 2026 • Friends
We visited Buzz Bbq beer during our holiday in Da Nang with a group of close friends and had the absolute best night out. The energy of the place is buzzing and lively, making it an extremely perfect venue for hanging out, drinking cold beers, and sharing delicious grilled food together. The barbecue was fresh, flavorful, and seasoned to perfection, and the staff kept our table well stocked with drinks without missing a beat. Everything from the friendly service to the fun atmosphere felt top-notch, plus the value for money was unbeatable for our big group. It is honestly a wonderfull spot to unwind after a long day of sightseeing around the city. If you are in Da Nang with friends looking for cold beer, tasty grilled meats, and a great vibe, you definitely cannot miss this place. We will absolutely be coming back next time we are in town.
